autorizacion_literal: Aplica este protocolo a la segunda semana y fija los criterios de selección antes de comparar modelos. Quiero que las advertencias tengan consecuencias y que no volvamos a descartar una alternativa sin una mejora clara.

metric.name: D2_Tweedie
metric.observation_link: fixed scoped link fitted on 2023 only, identical for all compared pricing models; predict observed T0 for evaluation, nominal exposure for ultimate test prediction
metric.delta_rule: primary lower simultaneous confidence bound must be strictly greater than delta_min
metric.rationale: Project risk tolerance chosen before candidate scores: 0.05% of full null deviance, equivalent to 50 units of a five-decimal score. Not a Kaggle requirement, fitted optimum or estimated power.

confirmation.denominator: full untrimmed null deviance recomputed within each resampled portfolio; common rows, weights and targets per pair
confirmation.priority: reference first, then challenger priorities 1..n fixed before opening 2024; promote sequentially only after a clear pairwise gain over current incumbent
confirmation.coverage_limit: Bonferroni allocation with approximate conditional bootstrap intervals; no exact coverage guarantee, selection-before-freeze correction or independent future-year validation

safeguards.scenario_definition: fixed reserve factors .75/1.25 on case reserve only, and 5%/10% unobserved cost-tail designs for bodily_injury/subsidence; common scenario and 2023-fitted observation link for both models, no validation-target fitting
safeguards.interpretation: Cold-start lower95 is a diagnostic non-inferiority safeguard, not an additional familywise confidence claim. Segment and stress limits are predeclared pointwise risk vetos, not tests that every segment must improve significantly.

warning_policy.block: Only resolved with hashed evidence can pass; acknowledgement or accepted limitation does not clear a blocker.
warning_policy.condition: Condition must be true and supported by hashed evidence; unresolved or unknown condition blocks promotion.
warning_policy.inform: Retained in act; does not create approval or remove other gates.

retirement: Only the incumbent actually replaced by a passing comparison is marked superseded; every other technically viable model remains preserved as an alternative.
public_score: Not an input to promotion, tie-breaking or retirement. Public-driven hypotheses remain exploratory without confirmation outside that same feedback.
changes_after_opening: No new batch, model, seed, margin or recipe under v1. A later explicit human amendment is versioned, preserves v1 and its failed results, and cannot restore an intact 2024 holdout.
